title: Design and Embedded Validation of Compact ML Models for Affective Touch Classification in a Soft Interactive Companion
abstract: arXiv:2607.16196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Soft plush companions provide a safe and intuitive platform for affective human-robot interaction, but their deformable structure and distributed tactile signals make reliable gesture recognition difficult. This study presents a complete workflow for developing and validating compact affective-touch classifiers for an interactive plush companion. A newly collected dataset comprised 1,326 labelled recordings before curation, including interactions from 25 children, teenagers, and adults. Each classifier received 2.5-s windows containing ten capacitive channels and one accelerometer-magnitude channel. translated_title: 软体交互伴侣中情感触觉分类的紧凑型机器学习模型的设计与嵌入式验证
translated_abstract: 软体毛绒伴侣为情感化人机交互提供了安全且直观的平台，但其可变形的结构和分布式的触觉信号使得可靠的手势识别变得困难。本研究提出了一套完整的开发与验证工作流程，用于为交互式毛绒伴侣构建紧凑型情感触觉分类器。新收集的数据集在整理前包含1,326条标注记录，其中包括25名儿童、青少年和成人的交互数据。每个分类器接收2.5秒的数据窗口，包含十个电容通道和一个加速度计幅值通道。MATLAB用于支持数据采集、质量控制、窗口生成，以及一项包含468次运行的扩张型一维卷积神经网络（1D CNN）探索性研究。随后，一个紧密对应的Python工作流程保留了参与者的数据来源信息，在每个数据折内部完成预处理拟合，并通过25折留一参与者交叉验证对入围模型进行评估。
tldr: 本研究提出了一套端到端工作流程，基于25名参与者共1,326条触觉交互记录，通过系统探索紧凑型扩张一维卷积神经网络并进行严格的留一参与者交叉验证，实现了软体毛绒伴侣上情感触觉手势的可靠分类与嵌入式验证。
en_tdlr: This study presents an end-to-end workflow for designing and embedded-validating compact dilated 1D CNN classifiers for affective touch recognition in a soft plush companion, using 1,326 labelled recordings from 25 participants and rigorous leave-one-subject-out validation.
